items.title: Benchmarking coding agents on the work developers bring to Kiro
items.en_title: Benchmarking coding agents on the work developers bring to Kiro
items.en_oneliner: Kiro has unveiled its internal benchmark KiroBench: more than 300 tasks drawn from real development work by Amazon engineers, spanning feature work, bug fixing, refactoring and other multi-turn scenarios, scored in runnable environments with verifiers to sidestep the leakage and narrow coverage of public benchmarks.

items.title: v2.4.2
items.en_oneliner: Open source AI coding agent OpenCode ships maintenance release v2.4.2, with no detailed changelog published this time.

items.title: Copilot code review billing will default to the organization
items.en_title: Copilot code review billing will default to the organization
items.en_oneliner: If you haven't picked a billing method for Copilot code review for licensed members, the cost will automatically be charged to your organization from December 30, 2026.

items.title: Building a software factory around human attention
items.en_title: Building a software factory around human attention
items.en_oneliner: The Kiro team shares a year of practice: agents run the full development cycle from discovery to release and monitoring on their own, with people stepping in only where a real decision is needed.

items.title: Where scientists draw the line on AI agents
items.en_title: Where scientists draw the line on AI agents
items.en_oneliner: Scientists discuss how far AI agents should go in research and which lines must not be crossed, drawing a reference boundary for agent autonomy.

items.title: v2.75.0 (2026-11-25)
items.en_oneliner: This release tightens instruction authority for workspace files, keeping RepoContext, Skills and Memory content below operator level, and adds a lowest_authority_under setting.
